simple.summary: אֲבִינֹעַם (ʼĂbîynôʻam) means Abinoam , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Judg 4 6.

definitions.full: H42. Abinoam אֲבִי֫נֹ֫עַם proper name, masculine ( my father is delight ) father of Barak Judg 4:6 , 12 ; 5:1 , 12 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 5278 ; father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious);
